name: Shoubousho
title: Dokkai Dojo
lead: JLPT reading drills N5-N1 set at a fictional neighborhood fire station, Aozora Shoubousho: a station-tour reservation notice, a first day helping at the station, a tour booking guide, a trial fire-safety consultation corner notice, a new-recruit training plan comparison, a column about noticing a familiar resident's change in manner during a fire-prevention patrol, a lesson teaching a new kouhai how to inspect and store equipment safely, an explainer on why on-scene hearing is still needed in the online-reporting era, a fire-extinguisher inspection service application guide, a column on how an online reporting system changed on-scene response work, a new rule for year-end extinguisher-inspection bookings, a column on the meaning of a veteran firefighter's skill for sensing a change at the scene, and a one-year cooperation report with a local elementary school's fire-safety education program. Original texts, answers with the reason for every choice.
